title: Review SIGA-CENTRAL-001 Spec Kit package
steps: Review the SIGA-CENTRAL-001 spec, plan, tasks, ADRs, continuity contract and acceptance matrix on the current branch.
Run documentation, diff and relevant exact-head checks available locally.
Confirm the M1 package remains proposed and that issue #24/CAS, fencing, entrypoint inventory and cutover approval remain explicit gates.
Keep runtime migration and merge/cutover out of scope until the required review and authorization occur.
Record non-blocking documentation defects for later follow-up without blocking the current review or PR.
acceptance: SIGA documentation is internally consistent, proposed-only status and blockers are explicit, and no unapproved production-readiness or merge claim is made.
